about: Camera spots for the countryside (S1, the scroll's start), in the one world frame (metres: X east, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X east, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand. Spots chosen from the layout's route and landmarks by the S1 area agent (Run 2).

from_seam.about: on the country road just east of the S2 seam, looking east into the village (the spawn), south of the lying buffalo and the runaway horse's lane, along the open lane between it and the hall's back (facing 8 -> 0, Run 3)

stall.about: the village stall under its willows: the thatched shed, the buffalo lying in front, the ox, the tipped barrow

vegetable_field.about: the 菜地: the raised bed of fourteen young trees, the pale rock at its corner, the man at the post calling the child

travellers.about: 迎寒策蹇: the hooded travellers on their donkeys riding east, the walker with his staff, the groom

hut.about: the thatched hut behind its tall wattle fences, the great hollow willow leaning over it, the shed on posts

great_willows.about: 隋堤烟柳: along the willow dyke under the great burled willows

sedan_party.about: the tomb-sweeping party coming home: the willow-decked sedan, its bearers, the rider and the porters

farmsteads.about: the thatched farmsteads behind their brushwood fences, the bare elms standing in the road strip

threshing_floor.about: 寂静的谷场: the open-fronted barn, the long farmhouse and the empty threshing floor

bridge.about: the small turf-decked plank bridge over the stream, the empty sampan moored beside it

charcoal_train.about: the charcoal donkey train walking east toward the scroll's start, under the big bare elms

ground_village_road.about: the ground pilot: the worn village road east from the seam, the 菜地's raised bed to the right

ground_vegetable_bed.about: the ground pilot: the 菜地's raised bed with its soil ridges and the pale standing rock at its corner

ground_hut_bank.about: the ground pilot: the hut's bank from the travellers' band, the route going up it at the turn

ground_dyke_road.about: the ground pilot: the willow road between the willow dyke and the banks stepping down to the silk's edge

ground_dyke_face.about: the ground pilot: the willow dyke's face from below, the great willows on its top

ground_climb.about: the ground pilot: the route climbing the two banks behind the massive willows to the farmsteads' terrace

ground_yard_bank.about: the ground pilot: the yard bank before the farmsteads from the terrace below, the nine trees on its top

ground_pale_band.about: the ground pilot: across the pale band (water) to its north bank and the terrace

ground_rocks.about: the ground pilot: the pale outcrop and the broken stony ground on the near bank

ground_threshing_floor.about: the ground pilot: the smooth pale threshing floor before the barn and the long farmhouse

ground_stream_banks.about: the ground pilot: the stream's banks, the inlet under the bridge and the elm's bank at its east end

ground_land_tongues.about: the ground pilot: the land tongues and the shoal's streaks in the open water
